mentions.name: Local transformer model training
mentions.description: A self-directed project to learn how to train transformer models locally so they can do useful work, aiming to replace paid Claude usage with locally trained models.
mentions.problem: Having to pay for Claude to get useful AI work done is costly, so the project seeks a local alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm learning how to train transformer models locally to do useful work instead of having to pay for claude. I regularly update my blog here https://seanneilan.com/posts
